fixture.composition: Real Account HTTP and composeMain with lifecycle, relay, Content, Access, Fuseki and PostgreSQL; no owner mocks.
fixture.creation: Public commands for Works, chapter Content/eligibility, real follows, independent Realm role-impact/change receipts and produced notices, operator-created Realms/Zones, and independent Account rating observations. Only the existing fixture authority helper supplies narrow preparation mandates.
fixture.reuse: Consistent stopped backups and mode-0600 corpus.json under .temp/audit-bounded-reads/{queries,notifications-governance,zones,ratings}/owners. The original notifications directory retains the disproved Feed fixture evidence. Every execution restores fresh isolated owners; no shared development storage.
fixture.privacy: Retained credentials never enter this document or Git.
fixture.instrumentation: Transparent HTTP proxy records actual graph requests, bytes, timing and trace IDs; optional 20 ms latency exposes in-flight cancellation without replacing an owner. Real OTLP runtime propagates traces. SQL/engine bounds are unknown until separately instrumented, never inferred as zero.

populations.notifications: 24 acknowledged permission changes affecting each of five signed-in recipients, authored by a separate Account in an auxiliary public Realm. Wait for durable recipient hints between commands, then verify visible subjects once. No unrelated Book/chapter preparation; book is null for this capability. Primary Realm roles remain intact. Original Feed corpus/evidence remains retained separately.
populations.zones: Ten operator-created public Realm/Zone pairs prepared through public commands; the first eight official at the retained cut, then the ninth and tenth configured official in the test. Each adopts the same public original through its own Realm-local selection.

fixture.preparationScope: Each capability build and restore independently remains within the existing 600-second active preparation ceiling; each regression project retains its existing 480-second wall. No raised timeout, candidate or population verifier limit.
fixture.setupProgress: Preparation emits phase/count/elapsed records with assertionReached false, so a setup failure cannot be reported as an outcome assertion.
fixture.productAssembler: All four API-built corpus files are commandOnlyIntegrationFiles. This keeps source capture and restored product owners in the same closed raw-update mode.
fixture.corpusLifetime: New primary moderator and auxiliary notice assignments last 24 hours to support reusable cuts. Earlier query/rating cuts retain their original one-hour primary moderator validity; exact run timestamps determine that persona premise. Account sessions are freshly authenticated after each restore.
fixture.preparationReadiness: Cheap durable notification hints confirm progress without repeatedly hydrating the growing inbox. Each fixed readiness interval remains 45000 ms; outer active preparation remains 600000 ms and catalogue-disk project wall remains 480000 ms.
fixture.officialAuthority: Zone population is prepared by the real platform administrator, with Account OAuth owner:operate consent in addition to zone:edit. Other measured personas still have no Access platform designation; public read disclosure is unchanged.

distinctions.null: Absent optional subject/display/rating/diagnostic value; never fabricate a preview or zero count.
distinctions.unknown: Membership count or unmeasured SQL/engine work stays unknown; do not turn it into exact zero.
distinctions.incomplete: A partial page carries an advancing continuation and at-least count, even when items is empty.
distinctions.unavailable: An unready/unavailable owner is an explicit 503; never return an exact empty page or null rating to hide it.
distinctions.noData: An exact zero-rating population has mean null and no-data precision; it differs from an unavailable aggregate.
